stage_requirements: exact LT-PIX SSOT identity and source hash
all required human listening passes complete
complete sequential BLK identity for the LT-PIX
each BLK label supported rather than guessed
exact Start TP and End TP with audible opening and closing proof
no vocal cut mid-word, mid-phrase, or before the section's intended completion
each BLK meaning reviewed independently from whole-song meaning
CCs used only as evidence and never as structural definitions
no legacy fixed window represented as a BLK
sub-10-second control passed or exact locked exception applied
triage_rules: Any incomplete proof remains TRIAGE unless a specific hard-stop condition applies.
An uncertain section label remains null with evidence notes; it is never guessed.
An uncertain boundary remains unresolved; a convenient timestamp is never substituted.
TRIAGE records cannot be returned by the production storefront.
hold_conditions: legacy fixed window presented as a BLK
unsafe or contradictory public use not yet controlled
missing indispensable authority source with no valid recovery path
